language.name: English
layout.utc: Every time and every day is in UTC.
entry.title: Enter a demo workspace
entry.intro: A demo workspace comes with links and synthetic traffic. Entering one takes no account and no password, and what you do inside is deleted when the workspaces are created again.
entry.cookie: Entering sets one cookie, which holds the session and nothing else. The session lasts twelve hours, or thirty minutes without use.
entry.none: This installation has no demo workspace to enter.
links.title: Links
links.caption: The links of the workspace, the oldest first
links.name: Link
link.synthetic: This is a demo workspace: its traffic is synthetic, generated by the seed.
period.label: Period
link.through: Figures with the events processed up to {moment}.
link.rules: Traffic classified with version {version} of the rules.
link.rules_changed: The classification rules changed in this period:
metric.requests.definition: Times the link redirected, whoever asked: it includes crawlers, previews and repeated clicks.
metric.estimated_human_clicks.definition: Redirects that the rules do not take for automated. It is an estimate from the headers of the request and errs by excess: not people and not unique clicks.
metric.inactive_requests.definition: Times the link was asked for while it did not redirect, being disabled, blocked or expired.
series.title: How often was the link requested each day?
series.summary: These {days} days had {requests} and {clicks}; the day with the most requests was {date}.
series.empty: The link was not requested in these {days} days.
series.table: Table with the figures of each day
series.caption: Requests and estimated human clicks of each day
referrers.title: Which sites did the estimated human clicks come from?
referrers.caption: Estimated human clicks by referring site
referrers.definition: The site is the host the request names as where it came from: only the host is kept, never the whole address. The table counts estimated human clicks only.
breakdown.summary: “{name}” has {clicks} of a total of {total}; no other value has more.
breakdown.empty: There was no estimated human click in these {days} days.
devices.title: Which kinds of device did the estimated human clicks come from?
devices.caption: Estimated human clicks by kind of device
devices.definition: The kind of device is worked out from the User-Agent header of the request, which each client writes as it likes: it is an estimate, and “Other” gathers what the rules do not tell apart. Only the kind is kept, never the header. The table counts estimated human clicks only.
browsers.title: Which browsers did the estimated human clicks come from?
browsers.caption: Estimated human clicks by browser
browsers.definition: The browser is worked out from the User-Agent header of the request, within the same limit: it is an estimate, and “Other” gathers what the rules do not tell apart. Only the family of the browser is kept, never the header. The table counts estimated human clicks only.
notfound.title: Not found
notfound.text: There is no page at this address.
failed.title: Something failed
failed.text: The page could not be prepared. Try again in a moment.
refused.title: The request was refused
refused.text: This form was sent from another site, so nothing was done. Go back to the panel and send it from one of its pages.
limited.title: Too many entries
limited.text: Too many sessions were opened from this address in a minute. Wait a moment and try again.
insecure.title: No session can be opened at this address
insecure.text: This installation is set up for a local run: it issues its session cookie only on a loopback address, such as localhost. At any other address it has to be served over HTTPS and be set up for it.

form.edit.title: Edit {name}

form.problems.one: There is {n} problem with what you sent
form.problems.other: There are {n} problems with what you sent

form.destination.label: Destination address
form.destination.hint: Where the short link leads. It begins with http:// or https://.
form.destination.allowed: This workspace only takes destinations that begin with:
form.alias.label: Alias (optional)
form.alias.hint: The path of the short link: 3 to 40 characters, a-z, 0-9 and hyphens. Left empty, one is generated. It cannot be changed later.
form.title.label: Title (optional)
form.title.hint: A name for the link in this panel. Whoever follows the link never sees it.
form.tags.label: Tags (optional)
form.tags.hint: Separated by commas, 20 at the most.
form.campaign.hint: They are added to the destination as utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_term and utm_content.
form.campaign.name: Campaign
form.expires.label: Expiry (optional)
form.expires.hint: In UTC. From that moment on the link no longer redirects.
delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.text: The short link stops working and its figures are no longer shown. This cannot be undone, and its identifier is never issued again.
busy.title: Too many changes
busy.text: This session made too many changes in a minute. Wait a moment and try again.
error.destination.too_long: The destination has more than 2,048 characters.
error.destination.characters: The destination has characters that an address cannot hold as they are: spaces, backslashes or letters outside ASCII. Write them percent-encoded.
error.destination.scheme: The destination has to begin with http:// or https://.
error.destination.credentials: The destination cannot carry a user name or a password.
error.destination.host: The host of the destination has to be a public domain name, not an IP address or a local name.
error.destination.port: The port of the destination has to be a number between 1 and 65535.
error.destination.dot_segment: The path of the destination cannot have segments that are . or ..
error.destination.redirect_domain: The destination cannot be the domain of the short links.
error.destination.not_allowed: This workspace does not take that destination.
error.alias.length: The alias has to have between 3 and 40 characters.
error.alias.characters: The alias can only have a-z, 0-9 and hyphens, with no hyphen at either end.
error.alias.taken: That alias is already in use.
error.campaign.characters: A campaign parameter has at most 200 characters, and no control characters.
error.campaign.conflict: The destination already carries one of these campaign parameters. Take it out of the destination or leave it empty here.
error.title.characters: The title has at most 200 characters, and no control characters.
error.tags.invalid: A link has at most 20 tags, of 1 to 40 characters each and none repeated.
error.expires_at.invalid: Write the expiry as a date and a time.
error.expires_at.past: The expiry has to be later than now.
error.quota: This workspace has as many links as it can hold. Delete one to create another.
error.blocked: The operator blocked this link: it can be deleted, not changed.
